description: This file defines the MethodInfo class, which models method signatures including name, return type, and parameters. It provides methods to generate method descriptors, add parameters, and normalize type names.

classes.name: MethodInfo
classes.description: A container for method metadata including name, return type, parameters, and methods for signature generation and type normalization.

methods.name: MethodInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a MethodInfo object with a method name and return type.

methods.name: getNameAndDescriptor
methods.description: Generates and returns the method's unique signature, combining the name, parameter types, and return type.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter type in human-readable form to the method, invalidates cached descriptor if present.

methods.name: normalizeTypes
methods.description: Normalizes the parameter and return types to their binary (descriptor) form using the provided ApiList.
